implementation: Capture only the result of the existing request_remaining_reservation transfer, with its original now_s, exact leg/chunk identities, full-leg route_id, anchor and follow UUID. Denied decision route_id may identify the retained hold, so request binding uses existing runtime data. No extra manager or observer calls.

Clear the display cache on grant, new leg and transition to the next stopped segment. The read-only helper requires request phase, matching request identity, denied hold decision for this robot and original timestamp within existing pose_ttl_s. Stale/future/malformed/missing or mismatched data uses the neutral Korean route-permission-wait label.

Only known peer blockers in occupied-tile decisions receive a Korean corridor-occupancy-wait label and actual peer names. Older conflicting requests receive a separate factual prior-request-wait label. No inferred blockers or deadlock assertion; other phases have concise factual Korean labels.

Project solely through existing waiting_reason. Display freshness uses absolute ROS simulation time, not mission elapsed time. Reservation, assignment, navigation and actuation behavior are unchanged.
